title: Random samples
hints: Shuffling a copy and taking the first k elements gives k distinct items chosen uniformly.
slices.Clone(items) makes the copy, so the caller's slice isn't reordered. r.Shuffle(len(s), func(i, j int) { s[i], s[j] = s[j], s[i] }) shuffles it.
Clamp k to the range [0, len(items)] before slicing: s[:k].
